//: Settings the modules read, for the hosts' user secrets (bjk-core, bjk-identity-server). Copy the sections a host needs into its own user-secrets.template.json. Locally these values are for development only; when deployed they come from container settings and secrets.

Safety.//: RequireAgeVerification defaults to false since 19 Oct 2026: posting, commenting and reacting no longer need the age check (it is only for viewing sensitive posts). Kept for future use; true makes write endpoints need the age_verified claim.

Posts.//: Where incidents may be posted: GB (the UK, the default when empty), IM (Isle of Man), JE (Jersey), GG (Guernsey).

Plans.//: Billing isn't built yet. The identity server will issue the access-token claim plan (free | premium | premium_plus; missing = free). Until then, Overrides gives chosen accounts a plan for testing: user id (GUID) -> plan. Remove them once the claim is issued.

Reels.//: Daily reel plays per UK calendar day: logged out (Anonymous) and Free; Premium and Premium + are unlimited. ViewerKeySecret: HMAC key for hashing logged-out viewers' ids and IP addresses (secret; set it in deployed environments). Other values are the defaults.

Heatmap.//: Cells and area figures with fewer than MinCellCount incidents are hidden (at least 2). History by plan in days: Free 7 (national teaser, no filters), Premium 365, PremiumPlus 1826 (5 years, plus CSV export).

Screening.//: The built-in keyword list always runs. Endpoint (optional) adds a classifier service (e.g. Detoxify in a sidecar): POST {"text"} -> {"scores": {...}}; empty = keywords only.

Captcha.//: Cloudflare Turnstile. Same keys as the identity server. Cloudflare's test secret below accepts every token (clients send XXXX.DUMMY.TOKEN.XXXX); deployed environments need the real one.

Queues.//: Durable queues in SQL Server (schema messaging of the badjockeys database); every key is optional and shown with its default. Which database holds them isn't a setting: the identity server says so in code (UseQueuesIn). See the README's Messaging section.

Media.//: Defaults shown; set only to change them. Limits since 19 Oct 2026: videos 30 s and 150 MB (157286400 bytes), photos 25 MB. Originals are deleted once their post is published; UnusedOriginalRetention is the most they're kept otherwise (failed, never posted).

Storage.//: SensitiveBucket: private bucket for the real files of sensitive media (served only by signed links). Optional; empty = the originals bucket under sensitive/. Set it (e.g. bjk-<env>-sensitive, no lifecycle rule, no public access) wherever the originals bucket deletes files after 90 days.

Processing.//: Worker only. Videos longer than SegmentSeconds are split into segment jobs processed in parallel by several replicas (0 = never split). FfmpegThreads 0 = every core of the replica. Keep MaxConcurrentJobs at 1 (one job per replica) and scale replicas. FeedImageMaxSize: longest side of photos' feed.webp copy.

Redaction.//: Worker only. Video frames are analysed at most DetectionMaxSize px (0 = full size). InferenceThreads 0 = every core. ExecutionProvider Cpu; Cuda only on a GPU worker image built with Microsoft.ML.OnnxRuntime.Gpu.

SensitiveDetection.//: Worker only. Nudity and graphic content checks with CLIP, scored on the blurring pass's frames. ModelPath set: CLIP runs. Empty: locally a stand-in that flags mostly red pictures; deployed, the worker won't start (Online Safety Act). A model that's missing or fails sends every upload to review. Thresholds are low on purpose (over-flag; moderators confirm or undo).

Chat.//: Ask Bad Jockeys (Chat module, bjk-core only). Model: an OpenAI-compatible server (Endpoint ending /v1, the model or deployment Name, and ApiKey if it needs one). No model is chosen yet (owner, 23 Oct 2026): leave them empty and the chat is a placeholder that logs each question it couldn't send (event 4905) and answers "not switched on yet", in every environment. The bjk_chat login's connection string is ConnectionStrings:BadJockeysChat in bjk-core. DailyQuestions and HistoryDays are the defaults. MisuseLimit: blocked questions a UK day before the chat pauses (default 5). HistoryKey: secret that signs the chat history (32+ characters; empty locally = a random key per run).
